Thanks — jumping in on the technical piece. Two points to include in the latency slide (drafted copy below):

1) Root cause: long-sequence batching behavior + a kernel path fallthrough for sequence lengths > 8k that increased CPU scheduling pressure. We pushed a partial fix (hotpatch) on 07/02 that reduced the 95th but left a handful of complex sessions impacted.

2) Mitigation timeline:
- 07/05: hotpatch (reduced 95th)
- 07/14: kernel-path rewrite landed in canary (observed 40% reduction in impacted sessions)
- 07/21: staged rollout to Dedicated pools (full rollout target 07/28)

Customer-facing bullets (suggested):
- We identified an edge case affecting very long sequences; a targeted rollout is underway and we expect user-visible latency to normalize by 07/28.
- No customer data was at risk; throughput improvements from batching lowered average cost across the fleet.

Also, quick flag on uptime: the 32m incident is covered in the incident appendix — operations already filed the RCA + postmortem link.
